answer: To thwart Sybil attacks, the network applies topological cut verifications across multi-agent auditing clusters. Nodes stake funds to validate peer task graphs. If a partition cut reveals colluding clones, stake slashing imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph density. Like spotting a velvet texture amidst rough cloth, or tracking a rogue comet against predicted orbits, auditors verify execution proofs as structured as a rigorous sonnet.
